en: The front of the postcard shows a sepia-toned image of a large villa with two-story wooden balconies, framed by foliage and garden plants. The caption at the bottom reads: 'Bad Pyrmont Villa Severin, Gartenseite.' The reverse side has handwritten German text, a green postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich, and a blue ink stamp from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont. It is addressed to Elise Klavenau in Vegesack, Bremen, with the street address 'Lange Str. 54'.
